description: This file defines the DatabaseTypeResolver class, which determines and resolves the database type (MySQL or PostgreSQL) based on the JDBC driver class name configured in HikariCP. It includes logic for initializing and accessing the current database type, and provides helper methods to check the database type.

classes.name: DatabaseTypeResolver
classes.description: A Spring component that resolves the current database type based on JDBC driver class name.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the database type after bean properties are set, determining the type based on the driver class name.

methods.name: determineDatabaseType
methods.description: Maps the driver class name to a DatabaseType enum, throwing an exception if unsupported.

methods.name: isPostgreSQL
methods.description: Returns true if the database type is PostgreSQL.

methods.name: isMySQL
methods.description: Returns true if the database type is MySQL.
